extDescription.message: Types text you paste, letter by letter, into the text field of the active tab. Adjustable speed; stop anytime with Esc.

popupTextLabel.message: Text to type in the current tab

popupHint.message: Click the target field first, then press “Type”. If no field is focused, it waits until you click one.

popupErrNoText.message: Paste the text you want to type first.

popupErrRestricted.message: This page doesn't allow extensions (e.g. chrome:// pages or the Chrome Web Store). Open a regular web page.

popupWaiting.message: Waiting for you to click a text field…

csBusy.message: A typing session is already running.

csNoText.message: There is no text to type.

csWaitOverlay.message: PasteScribe: click a text field to start (Esc cancels)

csFocusLost.message: Stopped: the field lost focus ($TYPED$ of $TOTAL$ characters).

csSkipped.message: ($SKIPPED$ could not be typed; is the field a custom editor such as Google Docs?)
